title: TelemetryEvent
description: Canonical telemetry event envelope carrying deployment-stage and runtime-binding references. Every event MUST prove its binding identity and deployment stage at ingest time (TEL-001 evidence contract E-1 through E-6).

event_id.description: Unique event identifier. Primary idempotency key for telemetry ingestion.

event_type.description: Canonical telemetry event type. Order/fill/deploy/rollback/governance events MUST NOT be sampled.

created_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when this event was generated by the runtime. Must be >= binding effective_at and < binding retired_at (if retired).

execution_mode.description: Runtime execution mode emitted by the active RuntimeBinding. For new events, this MUST equal deployment_stage so canary is not collapsed into live.

trace_id.description: Distributed tracing correlation ID. Injected by telemetry-ingest-svc if not provided by the producer.

environment.description: Legacy environment field. For v1+ events, MUST equal deployment_stage. Documented as a derived alias pending deprecation.

binding_id.description: RuntimeBinding.binding_id — identifies the exact binding that produced this event. Primary join key to RuntimeBindingStore. (Evidence E-1)

runtime_id.description: RuntimeBinding.runtime_id — the LEAN instance / container / worker that generated this event. (Evidence E-1)

capital_pool_id.description: RuntimeBinding.capital_pool_id — the capital pool this event belongs to. Used for pool-scoped queries and lineage joins. (Evidence E-1)

artifact_id.description: RuntimeBinding.artifact_id — the strategy/model artifact loaded. Required for performance attribution. (Evidence E-1)

artifact_version.description: RuntimeBinding.artifact_version — semver version of the artifact. (Evidence E-1)

deployment_stage.description: RuntimeBinding.deployment_mode mapped 1:1 into the telemetry envelope. Canonical deployment stage for this event. MUST match the deployment_mode of the binding referenced by binding_id. (Evidence E-2)

plan_id.description: RuntimeBinding.plan_id — the DeploymentPlan that triggered this binding. Proves governance admissibility. (Evidence E-3)

persona_capital_binding_id.description: RuntimeBinding.persona_capital_binding_id — links the event back through the binding to the persona registry. (Evidence E-3)

authority_refs.description: Explicit runtime authority and isolation references carried alongside binding evidence to show which runtime context emitted the event.

write_owner.description: Authoritative owner of binding-derived write context.

authority_source.description: Source of authority projection, e.g. runtime_binding.

runtime_role.description: Runtime role that emitted the event.

runtime_mode.description: Runtime mode that emitted the event.

workspace_ref.description: Persona-scoped workspace reference proving filesystem isolation.

auth_profile_ref.description: Persona-scoped auth profile reference proving secret isolation.

persona_id.description: Persona identifier bound to the runtime session.

session_id.description: Runtime session identifier for audit continuity.

trace_id.description: Trace identifier propagated from runtime session audit context.

request_id.description: Request identifier propagated from runtime session audit context.

rollback_parent.description: RuntimeBinding.rollback_parent — if this event was produced during a rollback, references the binding_id that was replaced. If set, rollback_action_type MUST also be set. (Evidence E-5)

rollback_action_type.description: RuntimeBinding.rollback_action_type — the rollback strategy used. If set, rollback_parent MUST also be set. (Evidence E-5)

broker.description: Broker / exchange name (optional, for trading events).

signal_id.description: Associated signal ID (optional, for signal-driven events).

run_id.description: Run / execution ID (optional, for experiment runs).

strategy_id.description: ID of the strategy this telemetry event relates to.

artifact_version.description: Artifact version (duplicate of top-level for legacy consumers).

lineage_ref.description: Optional lineage reference for cross-domain tracing.

action.description: Lifecycle action tag for non-metric events (deploy, rollback, kill-switch). Allows the event to pass minProperties=1 without inventing numeric telemetry.

heartbeat.description: Heartbeat pulse indicator for non-metric keepalive events. Value is always 1.

metrics.description: Event-specific metrics. additionalProperties allowed to support diverse event types.

order_id.description: Order identifier for order lifecycle and fill events (SD-09).

order_status.description: Order status at the time of this event (e.g. submitted, accepted, canceled, filled).

fill_status.description: Fill status alias populated for fill/partial-fill events alongside order_status.

quantity.description: Order or position quantity for order lifecycle and position snapshot events.

price.description: Order price or mark price for order lifecycle and position snapshot events.

symbol.description: Trading instrument symbol (e.g. SPY, AAPL) for order and position events.

position_qty.description: Current position quantity for position snapshot events.

metadata.description: Optional additional metadata. Not part of the evidence contract.

allOf.description: Evidence E-5: If rollback_parent is set, rollback_action_type MUST also be set.
Evidence E-5: If rollback_action_type is set, rollback_parent MUST also be set.
